title.en: One window only: One printed code, two building tables: which page
title.zh: 只留一个窗口：同一个代号、两张建筑表，看哪一页

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Use the page whose distance and aggregate you measured against. Taken from the printed row: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints HBT80-1816-110 on Electric 80 at 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical and aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Keep this cell as published. The same code string is on HBT80-16 at 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, horizontal 120 m, delivery height 360 m and aggregate 4 cm and below. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. High-rise and long-distance pumping is the Electric 80 scenario. Read it in the Xingtai table. Building and commercial placement is the HBT80-16 scenario.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：用你拿来对照过距离和骨料的那一页。邢台河北品锦机械在电动80上印 HBT80-1816-110：110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。同一串代号在 HBT80-16 上是 110 kW、50 m³/h、40 MPa、水平 120 m、输送高度 360 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。高层与长距离泵送是电动80的工况。建筑与商业浇筑是 HBT80-16 的工况。

body.en: Borrow “Dynamic (absolute) Viscosity” from “Dynamic, Absolute, and Kinematic Viscosity – Definitions & Conversions” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Read it in the Xingtai table. HBT80-1816-110 appears on Electric 80 (60 m³/h, 900 m / 300 m, ≤ 2 cm) and on HBT80-16 (50 m³/h, 120 m horizontal, 360 m height, ≤ 4 cm). Read it in the Xingtai table. High-rise and long-distance pumping is the Electric 80 scenario. Read it in the Xingtai table. Weights are 6000 kg and 6500 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. That sentence belongs to the Electric 80 table. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not send only the shared code. Read it in the Xingtai table. Both print 110 kW. Read it in the Xingtai table. These two published pages carry it. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/dynamic-absolute-kinematic-viscosity-d_412.html
body.zh: 把《Dynamic, Absolute, and Kinematic Viscosity – Definitions & Conversions》的“动绝对黏度”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。按邢台表上的原文理解：HBT80-1816-110 出现在电动80（60 m³/h、900 m / 300 m、≤ 2 cm）和 HBT80-16（50 m³/h、水平 120 m、高度 360 m、≤ 4 cm）上。按邢台表上的原文理解：请贴一个产品地址和石子粒径。不要只发那个共用代号。按邢台表上的原文理解：已公布的是这两页。HBT8018 是另一个代号 HBT8018-132S，电机 132 kW。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/dynamic-absolute-kinematic-viscosity-d_412.html

body.en: The reference page “Dynamic, Absolute, and Kinematic Viscosity – Definitions & Conversions” uses “Kinematic Viscosity” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. Taken from the printed row: Use the page whose distance and aggregate you measured against. Taken from the printed row: Building and commercial placement is the HBT80-16 scenario. Taken from the printed row: Hoppers are 0.7 m³ on Electric 80; HBT80-16’s table as published here lists pipe 100 / 125 mm and total weight 6500 kg without copying the Electric 80 hopper cell. Taken from the printed row: A 120 m horizontal infrastructure line can be discussed on HBT80-16 only if stone and output also match that page. Taken from the printed row: Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Taken from the printed row: Output, distance and aggregate still differ. Taken from the printed row: HBT8018 is a different code, HBT8018-132S, at 132 kW.
body.zh: 来源页《Dynamic, Absolute, and Kinematic Viscosity – Definitions & Conversions》用“黏度”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。用你拿来对照过距离和骨料的那一页。河北品锦机械（邢台）在电动80上印 HBT80-1816-110：110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。同一串代号在 HBT80-16 上是 110 kW、50 m³/h、40 MPa、水平 120 m、输送高度 360 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。高层与长距离泵送是电动80的工况。建筑与商业浇筑是 HBT80-16 的工况。目录里已经写着：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

body.en: “Viscosity and Reference Temperature” is an outline label from “Dynamic, Absolute, and Kinematic Viscosity – Definitions & Conversions”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints HBT80-1816-110 on Electric 80 at 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical and aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Keep this cell as published. 900 m is not a midpoint with 120 m. Keep this cell as published. Quote the URL. Keep this cell as published. Remote sites without a 110 kW supply leave both pages for a diesel row. Keep this cell as published. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Keep this cell as published. Both print 40 MPa.
body.zh: “黏度温度”是《Dynamic, Absolute, and Kinematic Viscosity – Definitions & Conversions》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。这一格照已印出的读：900 m 不是和 120 m 的中间值。电动80的垂直 300 m 也不是 HBT80-16 的输送高度 360 m。重量分别是 6000 kg 和 6500 kg。电动80料斗是 0.7 m³。这里公布的 HBT80-16 表列出管径 100 / 125 mm 和总重 6500 kg，不能把电动80的料斗格抄过去。请引用页面地址。这一格照已印出的读：两台都印 110 kW。输送量、距离和骨料仍然不同。

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Other Viscosity Units” from “Dynamic, Absolute, and Kinematic Viscosity – Definitions & Conversions”, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The same code string is on HBT80-16 at 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, horizontal 120 m, delivery height 360 m and aggregate 4 cm and below. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. 300 m vertical on Electric 80 is not the 360 m delivery height on HBT80-16. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The infrastructure page names Electric 80 (HBT80-1816-110) for horizontal distance up to 900 m. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Paste one product URL and the stone size. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Pressure alone does not choose the page. Headings already printed: Infrastructure may still be Electric 80
body.zh: 本节保留《Dynamic, Absolute, and Kinematic Viscosity – Definitions & Conversions》的标题“其余黏度单位”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。基建页点名电动80（HBT80-1816-110）的水平距离最高 900 m。这句话属于电动80的表。水平 120 m 的基建管路，只有石子和输送量也对得上时，才在 HBT80-16 上讨论。偏远工地供不起 110 kW，两页都让给柴油行。旁边那一台不在这句话里。两页都印 40 MPa。只有压力不能选定页面。已印出的标题：基建仍然可能是电动80

question.en: “Dynamic (absolute) Viscosity” does not change the check: Is the motor the same?
question.zh: “动绝对黏度”不改这一问：电机一样吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Both print 110 kW. Output, distance and aggregate still differ.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：两台都印 110 kW。输送量、距离和骨料仍然不同。

question.en: Which page has 40 MPa, once the outline says “Kinematic Viscosity”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“黏度”时，哪一页是 40 MPa？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: Both print 40 MPa. Pressure alone does not choose the page.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：两页都印 40 MPa。只有压力不能选定页面。

question.en: Under “Viscosity and Reference Temperature”, is there a third machine with this code?
question.zh: 在“黏度温度”这一节里，这个代号还有第三台吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. These two published pages carry it. HBT8018 is a different code, HBT8018-132S, at 132 kW.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：已公布的是这两页。HBT8018 是另一个代号 HBT8018-132S，电机 132 kW。
